# Wire format

## Canonical encoding rules

All wire objects are CBOR (RFC 8949) in the **deterministic/canonical** encoding (RFC 8949 ss4.2.1):
- Integers use the shortest form that represents the value.
- Map keys are sorted by their own encoded byte string, ascending.
- No indefinite-length items; no floating point (nothing in this format needs one).
- No duplicate map keys (rejected at decode by every conformant decoder; `models/wire_format.py`'s
  encoder cannot produce them since it encodes directly from a Python `dict`).

## Domain separation

Every record kind that can be chained (`models/hash_chain.py`) carries a domain tag string, included
in the hash alongside the payload so no two record kinds collide even on identical payload bytes:

| Tag | Used for |
|---|---|
| `CHAIN_COMMIT` | an ordinary authority-chain link |
| `IMAGE_COMMIT` | an `ACTIVATE_IMAGE` record (REQ-IMG-01) |
| `KEY_INSTALL` | a key-install-into-an-ACTIVE-slot record (REQ-LIFE-02) |
| `LABEL_DECLARATION` | a T2 label declaration (ADR-002, ss8.3's `label-declaration`) |

## CDDL (complete)

```cddl
transition-bundle = {
  1: 2,                          ; format version, currently fixed at 2
  2: bstr .size 112,             ; ac_tx v2 projection (the only bytes the locked stage parses)
  3: bstr,                       ; action-payload, bound by payload_digest
  4: [* evidence],               ; signatures by atom index
  5: receipt,                    ; publicity (REQ-PUB-01)
  ? 6: tstr .size (0..256),      ; human rationale, signed
  ? 7: bstr .size 32             ; ceremony-ref: hash of the T2 ceremony record (ADR on D-33)
}
evidence = [atom: uint .le 7, alg: uint, sig: bstr]
receipt  = { 1: tstr,                  ; log origin
             2: bstr,                  ; C2SP checkpoint (signed note body)
             3: [* bstr],              ; C2SP cosignatures
             4: [* bstr .size 32],     ; inclusion proof (RFC 9162 audit path)
             5: uint }                 ; leaf index
label-declaration = {
  1: [8* atom-decl],
  2: { * tstr => uint },         ; label name -> bit
  3: [* [uint, uint]],           ; declared-out-of-scope pairs (e.g. both families)
  4: bstr                        ; custody-graph digest from ac-ceremony
}
atom-decl = { 1: uint, 2: uint, 3: uint, 4: bstr .size 32 }   ; kind, alg_id, declared labels, ref
```

## Limitations [H]

This covers `transition-bundle`, `evidence` and `receipt` with real two-encoder agreement.
`label-declaration` and `atom-decl` are specified in CDDL above but have no generated vectors yet
(same encoder would handle them; just not exercised). No real C2SP checkpoint or RFC 9162 inclusion
proof bytes are used in these vectors — the `bstr` fields are filler bytes of the right size and
type, not output from a real log (see `models/witness_receipt.py`'s equivalent limitation for the
counting-rule side of this).
